name: CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-1
cards.audioText: Your call sign is CES582 from Wuhan to Beijing. Parking at Gate 223. When you are ready, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方582，飞机从武汉飞往北京。停机位223号。准备好时，请求ATC放行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES582, Gate 223, destination Beijing request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方582，223号机位，目的地北京，请求ATC放行。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-2
cards.audioText: CES582, Wuhan Delivery, standby one, I'll check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，武汉放行，稍等，我要检查你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText: Standing by, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-3
cards.audioText: Flight attendant told you passengers have boarded. All cargo doors are closed. Now report ready for clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务员告诉你乘客登机完毕。货舱门已关闭。现在报告准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES582, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方582，请求ATC放行。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-4
cards.audioText: CES582 cleared to Beijing, via flight planned route ZF-03 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m, departure frequency 124.5, squawk code 3415.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，可以按计划航路放行到北京，ZF-03离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，离场频率124.5，应答机编码3415。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing, via flight planned route, ZF-03 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m, departure 124.5, squawk 3415, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往北京，ZF-03离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，离场频率124.5，应答机编码3415，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-5
cards.audioText: CES582, read back correct, remain this frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，复诵正确，注意守听。
cards.referenceText: Wilco/remain this frequency, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办/守听，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-6
cards.audioText: 5 minutes later, no call from Delivery, ask about duration and reason of the delay.
cards.audioTextZh: 5分钟后，未收到放行消息，询问等待时间及延误的原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES582, confirm duration and reason of the delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方582，证实延误时间和原因。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-7
cards.audioText: CES582 due thunderstorm activity, flow control in effect. Expect 8min separation between each aircraft going same direction.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，由于雷雨活动，现在进行流量控制。同向飞机要保持8分钟间隔。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-8
cards.audioText: [Heavy rain is starting to fall, accompany with thunder and lightning.]CES582, Delivery, airport will be temporarily closed. Thunderstorms on final. Expect delay until the weather improves we will inform you as soon as the airport open.
cards.audioTextZh: 【开始下大雨了，伴有雷鸣和闪电。】东方582，放行，机场将暂时关闭。五边有雷暴。预计要延误到天气好转，机场开放时会立即通知你。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-9
cards.audioText: One hour later, the weather is getting better and the airport is open. Now ask for your departure sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 一小时后，天气好转，机场开了。现在向管制员询问你的离场顺序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES582, request my departure sequence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方582，询问下我的离场顺序。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-10
cards.audioText: CES582 you are currently No.1 in your direction. Expect about 20min delay. Contact Ground 121.8.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，目前你是你所飞方向的第一个。预计延迟20分钟。联系地面121.8。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-11
cards.audioText: Inform Wuhan Ground you are ready pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知武汉地面你已经准备好推出开车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES582, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方582，请求推出开车。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-12
cards.audioText: CES582, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing north.[You realize the tug is not in position yet. Advise Ground Control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，同意推出开车，头朝北。【你发现拖车没在。告诉地面指挥你还需要5分钟准备好。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES582, request another 5 minutes' due tug not in position.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方582，由于拖车没到位，请求再等待5分钟。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-13
cards.audioText: CES582 roger, standby push, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，收到，稍等推出，一会儿叫你。
cards.referenceText: Standing by, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-14
cards.audioText: CES582 Ground, confirm fully ready? We have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.[You need to open the cabin door to add passenger food and drinks due to the long delay. Advise Ground you'll need another 5 minutes for catering.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，地面，证实完全准备好了么？给你的离场是时间是10分钟之内。【由于长时间延误，你需要打开客舱门，装载乘客食物和饮料。告诉地面，你需要5分钟进行配餐。】
cards.referenceText: Request another 5 minutes due catering, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因为配餐，请求再推迟5分钟，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-15
cards.audioText: CES582 roger, report ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，收到，准备好报告。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-16
cards.audioText: 5 minutes later, catering completed. Call ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 【5分钟后，配餐完毕。报告准备好。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES582, Request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方582，请求推出开车。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-17
cards.audioText: CES582, pushback and start-up approved until abeam Gate 221. Do not block Gate 222, incoming traffic to that gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，同意推出开车，推到正切221号机位，不要挡住222机位，有进位飞机。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved until abeam Gate 221. Do not block Gate 222. CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，推到正切221号机位。不要挡住222机位。东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-18
cards.audioText: Engine start completed, now request for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 【发动机启动完毕，请求滑行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES582, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方582，请求滑行。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-19
cards.audioText: CES582 can you accept E1 intersection for departure? Takeoff roll is available 3300 meters.[Tell tower you can accept.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方583，你能否接受从滑行道E1进跑道起飞？起飞可用滑跑距离3300米。【告诉塔台你能接受。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm we can accept E1 intersection for departure, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们能接受从滑行道E1进跑道起飞，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-20
cards.audioText: CES582 roger, line up and wait runway 18L via taxiway E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，收到，从滑行道E1进跑道18左等待。
cards.referenceText: lining up and wait runway 18L via E1, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从滑行道E1进跑道18左等待，东方582。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-21
cards.audioText: Report to the Wuhan Tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告武汉塔台，前机挡住了滑行道E1。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES582, the aircraft in front of us block E1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方582，前方有飞机挡住了滑行道E1。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-22
cards.audioText: CES582, roger. Break, break, CSN326, taxi forward to be clear of E1.[The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，收到。还有，南航326，向前滑行，让开滑行道E1。【前机移动，你可以继续滑行上跑道等待。】
cards.referenceText: Tower, CES582, traffic is cleared, request continue taxi and line up runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塔台，东方582，活动清除，请求继续滑行进跑道18左等待。

cards.taskTitle: 27. CES582 · 延误与拖车未就位-23
cards.audioText: CES582. Cleared for takeoff runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582。可以起飞，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff runway 18L, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道18左，东方852。
